# Prototype animation dependencies

Unmodified official GSAP and ScrollTrigger browser distributions, version 3.15.1. The package tarball was retrieved from the official npm registry and checked against its published SHA-512 integrity value before extracting these two files. See `provenance.json` for the source and SHA-256 of each retained file.

Copyright/license notices remain in both scripts. License: [GSAP Standard License](https://gsap.com/standard-license/). No npm package license file was included in this distribution; the supplied script notices and license URL are preserved here.

These local copies support direct-file/offline design review. Production React integration should use a pinned package-manager dependency and the application lockfile. This directory is not an alternative production dependency-update mechanism.
